headline: Gold prices rise as US dollar and bond yields decline
summary: Spot gold prices increased by 1.9% to $4,139.29 per ounce in Singapore as the US dollar weakened and bond yields fell.
why: Gold is often viewed as a hedge against currency devaluation and inflation. Its price is inversely correlated with the strength of the US dollar and the level of real interest rates.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: The asset price rose directly in response to market conditions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Gold prices typically rise when the US dollar weakens and bond yields decline, as the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding bullion decreases.
